evidence.notes: Regular 2nd-group -ir verb with the -iss- extension (nous nous accroupissons); the pronominal form follows the same regular pattern.
Built on entendre, a 3rd-group -re verb; the dataset labels s'entendre irregular, and the expression inherits that conjugation.
Pronominal of the -er verb entraîner, which conjugates with the regular 1st-group pattern (circumflex stable throughout).
Built on faire, whose conjugation is irregular (fais, faisons, ferai, fait); the pronominal form follows faire.
Pronominal of the -er verb fouler, which conjugates with the regular 1st-group pattern.
